stories.title: Xi Jinping lands in the US for a state visit
stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, landed at Joint Base Andrews and were greeted by Donald and Melania Trump ahead of a state visit to the White House. The White House's arrival video got 20K likes, and a clip of Trump wincing at the military flyover while Xi stood still drew a 160K-like quote: "Absolutely mogged".
